Questions

Can I do it all on my phone?
[CONFIRM after the CapCut test: what needs a computer (install) and what works on a phone (edit, post)]
How do I edit the carousel?
Open its Canva link (a free account works), swap the photos and type over the [brackets].
Is music included?
No. The Reels have no audio: no music and no sound effects. Add a sound in Instagram after you upload, so your Reel never gets muted.
Do I need to install fonts?
No, they come with the template.
How do I change the words?
Double-click a text box and type.
My computer warns me about the installer.
That is normal. Click More info, then Run anyway.
Can I swap a clip?
Yes. Right-click it on the timeline and choose Replace.
Do I need CapCut Pro or Canva Pro?
No. The templates open in free CapCut and the carousels in free Canva. [CONFIRM: no Pro features, from the CapCut test of all 25]

Listing description

Five cute Halloween Reel templates for CapCut, each with a selling job: open a once-a-year sale, show what's included, share your favourites, turn a common mistake into your offer, or announce a last chance. Film a few clips on your phone, drop them in a folder and double-click the installer: the template opens in CapCut with your clips in place. Type your words over the brackets and export. Each template comes with a shot list, a recipe card, a one-page guide, a phone kit and a matching Instagram carousel you can edit free in Canva. Each one suggests a sound to add in Instagram (no sound files included).

Demo footage to film

One finished demo Reel per template, made from your own clips run through the real installer. Never the after.mp4 previews (they show other brands' products). Use your own product throughout, for example a Scrolly tee or the Business Brain on your laptop screen. Also film the how-to video for the How it works section.
